# pbs_users (Data Source)

Lists the users of a Proxmox Backup Server. With Sys.Audit on /access/users the list has every user; without it, PBS shows only the user the provider signs in as.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The users of PBS's own realm, leaving out root@pam and the other accounts
# of the host.
data "pbs_users" "local" {
  realm = "pbs"
}

output "local_users" {
  value = [for u in data.pbs_users.local.users : u.userid]
}

# Disabled users, as candidates for a clean-up. An expired user cannot sign
# in either; compare expire with a timestamp to find those.
output "disabled_users" {
  value = [for u in data.pbs_users.local.users : u.userid if !u.enable]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `realm` (String) List only the users of this realm, such as `pbs` or `pam`.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The users, sorted by user ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `email` (String) Email address; null when there is none.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the user may sign in.
- `expire` (Number) When the account expires, in seconds since the Unix epoch; `0` for never.
- `firstname` (String) First name; null when there is none.
- `lastname` (String) Last name; null when there is none.
- `userid` (String) User ID, such as `alice@pbs`.
